variants.title: Radiation pattern of a horn antenna in the H-plane
variants.sample: Pyramidal horn 7.0 x 5.2 cm at 10.5 GHz
variants.unknown: the H-plane beam width and the gain
variants.note: In the H-plane the aperture field is cosine-tapered across the 7.0 cm width, so the beam is wider for its size than in the E-plane and the side lobes are lower. Horn dimensions are illustrative.

source.title: C. A. Balanis, Antenna Theory: the pyramidal horn
